notes: No login request: the Python client never calls auth/login; the host's loopback whitelist on the qBittorrent socket proxy admits it (src/atrium/media/qbit.py). The Go port keeps that.
The base URL is `http://qbit.test` (QBITTORRENT_URL); every path sits under `/api/v2/`.

scenarios.description: Every Qbit request: torrents/info (no filter, filter=completed, tag=media, hashes=), torrents/files, torrents/add (magnet with and without tags; .torrent upload as multipart with and without tags), addTags, filePrio (skip and normal), start, delete (deleteFiles true and false).
scenarios.name: client_requests

scenarios.description: torrents/add accepted with the legacy "Ok." body, then refused by a JSON tally with failure_count and by "Fails." (both raise QbitError).
scenarios.name: add_answers

scenarios.description: channels.poll twice: the first pass primes (EZTV only), the second adds the new matching release tagged media, notifies ntfy with topic and click, then selects files (info tag=media, files, filePrio, addTags selected, start). Holds the EZTV and ntfy requests of the flow too.
scenarios.name: channel_poll
